name: Shadow Chimp
summary:
Shadow Chimp is a VR horror game set in an abandoned research facility, full of mystery and tension. Players step into a chilling world where remnants of long-forgotten experiments hint at a catastrophic event. Once a hub of groundbreaking research, the facility now stands deserted, decayed, and eerie.
